name: special_plus_snan_with_payload
citation: MISB ST 1201.3 §7.2.3, Table 1 (the two-bit indicator) and Table 2
note: MUST NOT be run through the reverse map. Reverse-mapping this pattern returns a finite float and raises nothing, so a decoder that skips ST 1201.3 §7.2.2 step 1 hands its caller a number. The number lands ABOVE b — a Table 2 pattern sets the top two bits, so it exceeds the largest normal value structurally — which means a caller that range-checks catches it and a caller that does not gets a silent lie. The codec returns a Special so neither caller has to.
